name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.189.0 — Genesis, the run design stage and /spec:sketch read the mock app instead of HTML mocks: the grounding contract's design block is just { app }, the design stage is preflight → reconcile → look → stamp over approved, hash-current screens, genesis auto-picks the frontend and skips the scaffold tournament when a mock app exists and lands the skeleton on mock-review check, /spec:init stops offering frontend-design, and the render-gate and design-ac-reconcile scripts are deleted. 7.188.0 — The mocks pipeline now drives a real Vite + React + shadcn app instead of gray HTML wireframes: a new spec/templates/mock/contract.json fixes the one contract with the separate @555/mock-review reviewer package, spec/scripts/lib/mock-cli.js is the sole caller (refusing on a version mismatch or a missing binary with a remedy), and mocks-driver.js is rewritten over SEED → SHELL → SCREENS → THEME → CLIENT → APPROVED with every mark derived from design/notes.json, design/approval.json and check --json; the provenance ledger's verbs and gate are unchanged, and every retired verb from the old HTML-driven driver refuses with a remedy. 7.187.0 — The screen page (/screen/<label>.html, specs/20260913/06) now collapses to one full-width board column on phones: its own grid rule outranked viewer.css's 480px breakpoint, so on a phone the board was squeezed into a ~30px column beside the bottom-sheet inspector. The breakpoint now re-prefixes .rv-screen .rv-main, pinned by a real-Chrome width measurement at 390px and 1280px.
